meta.title: AK Maison Biryani | South Indian Cuisine in Montreal
meta.description: AK Maison Biryani, authentic Indian cuisine at 431 Boul. Henri Bourassa East, Montreal. Biryani, tandoori, dosa and kottu roti.

common.logoHome: AK Maison Biryani, back to top

hero.intro: Discover the rich aromas, authentic spices, and unforgettable flavours of South Indian cuisine at AK Maison Biryani.

story.p1: AK Maison Biryani is a South Indian cuisine destination in the heart of Montreal, created around the dishes that define a generous Indian table: aromatic biryani, golden dosa, smoky tandoori and slow-simmered curries.
story.p2: Every plate is meant to be shared. Come with your family and friends, and enjoy the warmth of true Indian hospitality alongside flavours rich in spice and tradition.

blurbs.biryani: Fragrant rice layered with authentic spices and rich flavours.
blurbs.dosa: Rice flour pancakes, served with sambar and chutney.
blurbs.kottu: Chopped roti stir-fried with your choice of protein.

menu.intro: From aromatic biryanis to traditional South Indian favourites, discover a collection of authentic flavours crafted to make every meal memorable.
menu.backToTop: Back to the top of the menu

appetizers.name: Appetizers
appetizers.description: Crispy samosas, pakoras and chaats, plus soups and street-food favourites to begin the meal.

biryani-rice.name: Biryani & Rice
biryani-rice.description: Fragrant biryani layered with rice and authentic spices, alongside fried rice and classic steamed rices.

chicken.name: Chicken
chicken.description: Tender chicken in creamy, tangy and richly spiced sauces, from butter chicken to vindaloo.

lamb.name: Lamb
lamb.description: Lamb curries, plus mutton curry and beef deviled, in rich and deeply spiced sauces.

vegetables.name: Vegetables
vegetables.description: Vegetarian curries, paneer dishes, lentils and chickpeas, cooked the Indian way.

seafood.name: Seafood
seafood.description: Shrimp prepared in creamy, spinach and curry sauces.

tandoori.name: Tandoori
tandoori.description: Marinated in yogurt and spices, then roasted in the clay oven.

dosa.name: Dosa
dosa.description: Rice flour pancakes, served with sambar and chutney.

kottu-roti.name: Kottu Roti
kottu-roti.description: Chopped roti stir-fried with chicken, shrimp, mutton, beef or cuttlefish.

breads.name: Breads
breads.description: Naan and paratha to go with every curry.

naan-roll.name: Naan Rolls
naan-roll.description: Naan wrapped around paneer, chicken tikka or lamb kabab.

sides.name: Side Orders
sides.description: Raita, salad, chutneys and pickles on the side.

desserts.name: Desserts
desserts.description: Traditional Indian sweets to finish the meal.

thali.name: Thali
thali.description: A complete tray with the curry of your choice, with lunch and dinner prices.

r1.title: Authentic South Indian Cuisine
r1.text: Biryani, dosa, tandoori and traditional meals, rooted in the flavours of South India.

r2.title: Rich Traditional Flavours
r2.text: Layered spices and slow cooking that give every dish its depth and aroma.

r3.title: Carefully Selected Ingredients
r3.text: Fresh herbs, whole spices and quality rice, chosen with care for every plate.

r4.title: Warm Indian Hospitality
r4.text: A welcome that treats every guest like family, from the first greeting to the last bite.
